CREATE TABLE #TEMP_TBL
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = HASH(CUST_ID)
,    HEAP
)
AS
SELECT
    AS_OF_DATE
    ,CUST_ID
    ,GAM_ACID
    ,ACCT_CRNCY_CODE
    ,GAM_BANK_ID
    ,GAM_SCHM_TYPE
    ,GAM_SCHM_CODE
    ,OUTSTANDING_BALANCE
    ,OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP
    ,DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS
FROM EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT
where ACCT_CRNCY_CODE <> 'PHP'
;
DROP TABLE EDS.DEPOSIT_NONPHP_YTD;
 
 
CREATE TABLE EDS.DEPOSIT_NONPHP_YTD
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = HASH(GAM_ACID)
,    HEAP
)
AS
SELECT
      TMP.FULLDATE
    , TMP.Previous_Business_Day
    , TMP.CUST_ID
    , TMP.GAM_ACID
    , TMP.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE
    , TMP.GAM_BANK_ID
    , TMP.GAM_SCHM_TYPE
    , (CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE ELSE CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE END) AS CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE
    , (CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP ELSE CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP END) AS CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP
    , CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE AS PREVIOUS_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE
    , CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP AS PREVIOUS_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP
    , SUM(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE ELSE CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE END)
        OVER(PARTITION BY YEAR, TMP.GAM_ACID ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS TOTAL_CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE
    , SUM(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP ELSE CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP END)
        OVER(PARTITION BY YEAR, TMP.GAM_ACID ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS TOTAL_CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP
    , DAYOFYEAR
    , LastDayOfMonth
    , Day
    , (SUM(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE ELSE CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE END)
      OVER(PARTITION BY YEAR, TMP.GAM_ACID ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) 
        + case when month_end = 'Y' then month_end_diff * CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE else 0 end) / (DAYOFYEAR + case when month_end = 'Y' then month_end_diff else 0 end) AS YTD_BALANCE
    , (SUM(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP ELSE CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP END)
        OVER(PARTITION BY YEAR, TMP.GAM_ACID ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW )
        + case when month_end = 'Y' then month_end_diff * CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP else 0 end) / (DAYOFYEAR + case when month_end = 'Y' then month_end_diff else 0 end) AS YTD_BALANCE_PHP
    , (SUM(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE ELSE CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE END)
      OVER(PARTITION BY YEAR, MONTH, TMP.GAM_ACID ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) 
        + case when month_end = 'Y' then month_end_diff * CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE else 0 end) / (DAY + case when month_end = 'Y' then month_end_diff else 0 end)AS MTD_BALANCE
    , (SUM(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP ELSE CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP END)
        OVER(PARTITION BY YEAR, MONTH, TMP.GAM_ACID ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW )
        + case when month_end = 'Y' then month_end_diff * CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP else 0 end) / (DAY + case when month_end = 'Y' then month_end_diff else 0 end) AS MTD_BALANCE_PHP
    , TMP.MONTH_END
FROM
    (
        SELECT FULLDATE
            , Previous_Business_Day
            , Business_Day_Flag
            , DAYOFYEAR
            , LastDayOfMonth
            , Day
            , case when month_end = 'Y' then DATEDIFF(day, fulldate, LastDayOfMonth) else 0 end month_end_diff
            , YEAR
            , MONTH
            , CUST_ID
            , GAM_ACID
            , ACCT_CRNCY_CODE
            , GAM_BANK_ID
            , GAM_SCHM_TYPE
            , MONTH_END
        FROM EDS.DATE_DIM
        JOIN EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT
            ON 1 = 1
            AND SUBSTRING(GAM_SCHM_CODE, 1, 2) <> '09'
            AND ACCT_CRNCY_CODE <> 'PHP'
            AND (AS_OF_DATE = '2024-08-06' OR (DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS = 'C' and  AS_OF_DATE >= '2024-01-01'))
        WHERE FULLDATE BETWEEN CAST ('20231229' AS DATE) AND CAST ('20240806' AS DATE)
    ) TMP
LEFT JOIN #TEMP_TBL CURRENT_BD
    ON  TMP.FULLDATE = CURRENT_BD.AS_OF_DATE
        AND TMP.GAM_ACID = CURRENT_BD.GAM_ACID
LEFT JOIN #TEMP_TBL CURRENT_PBD
    ON  TMP.Previous_Business_Day = CURRENT_PBD.AS_OF_DATE
        AND TMP.GAM_ACID = CURRENT_PBD.GAM_ACID;

INSERT INTO EDS.DEPOSIT_NONPHP_YTD

(
FULLDATE
,Previous_Business_Day
,CUST_ID
,GAM_ACID
,ACCT_CRNCY_CODE
,GAM_BANK_ID
,GAM_SCHM_TYPE
,CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE
,CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP
,PREVIOUS_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE
,PREVIOUS_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP
,TOTAL_CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE
,TOTAL_CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP
,DAYOFYEAR
,LastDayOfMonth
,Day
,YTD_BALANCE
,YTD_BALANCE_PHP
,MTD_BALANCE
,MTD_BALANCE_PHP
,MONTH_END
)
 
SELECT
    REPLACE(A.CURRENT_EOD_DATE,'2024-03-31','2024-03-27') AS FULLDATE
    , NULL AS Previous_Business_Day
    , B.CUST_ID AS CUST_ID
    , A.ACID AS GAM_ACID
    , B.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE
    , A.BANK_ID AS GAM_BANK_ID
    , NULL AS GAM_SCHM_TYPE
    , B.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE AS CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE
    , B.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP AS CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP
    , NULL AS PREVIOUS_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE
    , NULL AS PREVIOUS_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP
    , A.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL AS TOTAL_CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE
    , A.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL AS TOTAL_CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP
    , C.DAYOFYEAR
    , C.LastDayOfMonth
    , C.Day
    , A.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL/C.DAYOFYEAR AS YTD_BALANCE
    , A.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL/C.DAYOFYEAR AS YTD_BALANCE_PHP
    , (SUM(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN B.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE ELSE B.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE END)
      OVER(PARTITION BY YEAR, MONTH, A.ACID ORDER BY A.CURRENT_EOD_DATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) 
        + case when month_end = 'Y' then DATEDIFF(day, fulldate, LastDayOfMonth) else 0 end * B.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE) / (DAYOFYEAR + case when month_end = 'Y' then DATEDIFF(day, fulldate, LastDayOfMonth) else 0 end)AS MTD_BALANCE
    , (SUM(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN B.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP ELSE B.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP END)
        OVER(PARTITION BY YEAR, MONTH, A.ACID ORDER BY A.CURRENT_EOD_DATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW )
         + case when month_end = 'Y' then DATEDIFF(day, fulldate, LastDayOfMonth) else 0 end * B.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP) / (DAYOFYEAR + case when month_end = 'Y' then DATEDIFF(day, fulldate, LastDayOfMonth) else 0 end) AS MTD_BALANCE_PHP
    , 'Y' AS MONTH_END
    FROM
        (SELECT *
            ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CURRENT_EOD_DATE, ACID, BANK_ID ORDER BY ACID) RN
            FROM busc.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES
            WHERE CURRENT_EOD_DATE IN ('2023-12-29','2024-01-31','2024-02-29','2024-03-31')
                AND BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
            ) A
        JOIN eds.DEPOSIT_FACT B 
            ON A.ACID = B.GAM_ACID
            AND A.BANK_ID = B.GAM_BANK_ID
            AND A.CURRENT_EOD_DATE = (CASE WHEN B.AS_OF_DATE = CAST('20240327' AS DATE) THEN CAST('20240331' AS DATE) ELSE AS_OF_DATE END)
            AND B.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP'
        LEFT JOIN eds.DATE_DIM C
            ON A.CURRENT_EOD_DATE = C.FULLDATE
    WHERE A.RN = 1
